paragraphs.source_en: Motoyasu glanced at his retainers and said softly, “Of late I have truly had no leisure to consider the matter. It will be soon enough to inform you when the time comes. paragraphs.source_en: Utterly won over, Kazumasu prostrated himself. Everything before him seemed like a dream. Though he idolized Nobunaga and wished to follow him all his life, Motoyasu's every word and deed stirred him so deeply that he wondered whether he should seek a new and worthier lord. There was always a greater heaven beyond heaven! If Nobunaga was a roaring blaze, the Motoyasu before him brought to mind the moon, quietly shedding its radiance above the flames.

paragraphs.source_en: In the first month of the following year, Eiroku 5, Motoyasu visited Kiyosu Castle. Some retainers, fearing for his safety, urged him not to go, but he paid them no heed. Nearly a year had passed since Takigawa Kazumasu left Okazaki. The impatient Nobunaga must have been longing all that while for Motoyasu to come; if the visit were delayed any further, it would lose its meaning.

paragraphs.source_en: Moreover, Ujizane in Sunpu had already set out upon the road to ruin. Though the fierce and violent Nobunaga restrained himself and took no action, Ujizane still dared not avenge his father. Enraged that Motoyasu would not come to Sunpu, he drove more than ten members of the household of Motoyasu's kinsman Matsudaira Iehiro outside Yoshida Castle and had them beheaded before the public. If Motoyasu went to Sunpu for fear that still more hostages would be killed, what then would become of Owari and Mikawa?

paragraphs.source_en: Given Nobunaga's violent nature, he would surely seize the opportunity to invade Okazaki. For that reason Motoyasu repeatedly declared that he could not leave Okazaki Castle, yet Ujizane's suspicions did not diminish in the least. Motoyasu had no choice but to devote himself to dealing with the Oda. This state of affairs persisted from Eiroku 3, when Yoshimoto was killed, until the second month of Eiroku 4, when Takigawa Kazumasu came to propose an alliance.
